contentvec-original.revision_scope: Author repository revision for license and checkpoint link; checkpoint identity is pinned by SHA-256.
contentvec-original.license_basis: Author repository MIT LICENSE and its official ContentVec_legacy 500 checkpoint link; no separate checkpoint license file supplied.
contentvec-original.notice: Original ContentVec license is preserved verbatim, including its supplied incomplete copyright line. This conversion omits training labels and optimizer state.

chinese-original.license_basis: Original publisher model-card license metadata at the pinned revision.
chinese-original.notice: The upstream card declares MIT and supplies no separate copyright line or license file. The original card and standard MIT permission text are preserved; no copyright holder is invented.

korean-original.license_basis: Original publisher model-card license metadata at the pinned revision.
korean-original.notice: The original publisher card declares Apache-2.0. No upstream NOTICE file is present in the recorded fixed-revision file inventory. ONNX conversion and output selection are modifications; original publisher attribution is preserved.

japanese-contributor-mirror.revision_scope: Original contributor's mirror revision; config and checkpoint are byte-identical to the pinned Applio distribution.
japanese-contributor-mirror.publisher: rinna Co., Ltd. (original); Yukiya Hono / yky-h (contributor mirror)
japanese-contributor-mirror.license_basis: The contributor mirror's fixed model card explicitly preserves the original model's Apache-2.0 license and original authors' copyrights.
japanese-contributor-mirror.notice: Original model attribution and the mirror card are preserved. No NOTICE file or separate copyright line is supplied at the fixed mirror revision. ONNX conversion and selection of layer 12 without final projection are modifications. No upstream ONNX is reused or relicensed.
